groups.condition: Its nesting depth was accepted by parsing.
groups.capability: Print the array without rejecting its accepted depth.
groups.consequence: Printing fails solely because of nesting depth.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same accepted-depth array printing requirement.

groups.condition: Its nesting depth was accepted by parsing.
groups.capability: Print the object without rejecting its accepted depth.
groups.consequence: Printing fails solely because of nesting depth.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same accepted-depth object printing requirement.

groups.operation: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child in an array or object.
groups.condition: A valid input and setup supplies a supported cJSON_Raw child.
groups.consequence: The child printing path cannot be reached through the harness.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both concern reachability of Raw child printing across arrays and objects, with the same unresolved setup condition.

groups.condition: Its output depth is at least CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
groups.capability: Reach the array printer's nesting rejection.
groups.consequence: The parse-only harness cannot exercise that rejection.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct from printing parser-produced arrays at accepted depths.

groups.condition: Its output depth is at least CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
groups.capability: Reach the object printer's nesting rejection.
groups.consequence: The parse-only harness cannot exercise that rejection.
groups.equivalence_reason: Distinct from the array rejection and from printing parser-produced objects at accepted depths.

groups.operation: Print an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
groups.condition: A supported setup constructs and inserts a cJSON_Raw array element.
groups.consequence: The parse-only harness cannot reach raw array-element printing.
groups.equivalence_reason: Specific to an array element; the broader Raw-child claim also covers objects.

groups.operation: Print an object containing a cJSON_Raw member value.
groups.condition: A supported setup constructs and inserts a cJSON_Raw object member.
groups.capability: Pass the member value to print_value.
groups.consequence: The parse-only harness cannot reach raw object-member printing.
groups.equivalence_reason: Specific to an object member; the broader Raw-child claim also covers arrays.
